item.text: The options are currently recomputed inside `ViewRoom`, which also means the refresh depends on navigation. I’m moving that computation behind a dedicated `RoomLoaded` action, dispatching it when `RoomView` first has the room, and fixing initial event selection to fall back to the component state.
